title: ADHD as a circadian rhythm disorder: evidence and implications for chronotherapy (2025)
summary: This article examines ADHD through the lens of circadian rhythm disruption, reviewing evidence that sleep-wake cycle abnormalities contribute to attention and impulse-control symptoms. It discusses implications for chronotherapy—treating ADHD via light exposure, melatonin timing, and sleep scheduling—as a complement or alternative to stimulant medication.
